title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - PhysicalConnectivityServiceOffering
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/PhysicalConnectivityServiceOffering. Definition marked 'TBD' (to be determined) in the source ontology. Subclass of ConnectivityServiceOffering per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the ConnectivityServiceOffering model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PhysicalConnectivityServiceOffering'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

circuitType.description: Property. Type of access medium: wired medium access or wireless medium access.

interfaceType.description: Property. For the chosen circuit type, the interface type specification needed for interoperability requirements.
